prompt:
Project Title: AI Automation Systems Library Homepage
Purpose: Master architectural directory cataloging user-facing AI Agents and operational backend Automations.
Target Audience: Internal technical operations, scale-focused business founders, and system integration engineers.
Output Format: Responsive semantic HTML5 framework with inline vanilla JS architecture filtering against a static JSON array.

Visual Style Instructions (Aesthetic: Swiss Minimalist Command Vault):
- Layout Matrix: Fixed asymmetrical grid system using alternating CSS Grid blocks. Thick structural borders (2px solid #111) with a master 0px border-radius standard.
- Color Palette: Deep Void Black background (#020202), Pure Stark White card canvases (#FFFFFF), Electric Cyan (#00E5FF) for interactive agent triggers, Matrix Green (#00E676) for automation state signals, and cold Technical Gray (#475569) text.
- Accent Elements: Strict data density, zero blur, high-contrast monospace typographic telemetry indices, and high-visibility status tags.

Component Breakdown & Interaction Logic:
1. INFRASTRUCTURE DUAL HEADER CONTROLLER:
   - Split navigation bar showing total system capacity index: [LIVE AGENTS: 25] | [ACTIVE WORKFLOWS: 34].
   - Search utility console with text input anchor: "Query system identifiers, dependencies, or metadata tags..."

2. DUAL ARCHITECTURE CORE GRID PATHWAY:
   - Left Master Block (Agent Stack): Accent border in Electric Cyan. Features display text: "AI AGENTS [User-Interactive Interface Matrix]".
   - Right Master Block (Automation Stack): Accent border in Matrix Green. Features display text: "BACKEND AUTOMATIONS [Programmatic Processing Pipelines]".
   - Interactive Logic: Clicking a node fires a client-side filter array updating the downstream directory layout instantly.

3. DIRECTORY METADATA CARD ARCHITECTURE:
   - Item row components driven by static JSON blocks. Each cell features:
     - Header: Unified Title string + Slug lookup ID indicator.
     - Metadata Block: Mono-spaced grid rows pulling: [Category] | [Platforms Involved] | [Difficulty Level (Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced)] | [Monetization Code].
     - Interactive Trigger Actions: Primary "Inspect Blueprint Architecture" button executing a deep layout takeover or detail modal routing path.

Mobile/Accessibility Standards:
- Complete structural compilation for mobile viewports: Layout rows re-stack seamlessly on a single-column block system.
- Touch target dimensions strict at a minimum of 48px footprint. High-contrast ratio enforced natively via solid stark black characters layered across flat paper-white panels. No low-contrast typography overlaps.
